scripts.install:apps: corepack pnpm@10.15.1 --dir OnMyWay_BE_V3 install && corepack pnpm@10.15.1 --dir OnMyWay_FE_V3 install && corepack pnpm run install:ios
scripts.install:bundler: gem list bundler -i -v 2.4.2 || gem install --user-install bundler -v 2.4.2
scripts.install:ios: corepack pnpm run install:bundler && corepack pnpm run pod:install
scripts.pod:install: cd OnMyWay_FE_V3 && BUNDLE_PATH=vendor/bundle bundle _2.4.2_ install && BUNDLE_PATH=vendor/bundle bundle _2.4.2_ exec pod install --project-directory=ios
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "corepack pnpm run dev:backend" "corepack pnpm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:reset: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,magenta "corepack pnpm run dev:backend" "corepack pnpm run dev:frontend:reset"
scripts.dev:android: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend,android --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "corepack pnpm run dev:backend" "corepack pnpm run dev:frontend" "NODE_ENV=development corepack pnpm --dir OnMyWay_FE_V3 exec react-native run-android --no-packager --active-arch-only"
scripts.dev:android:reset: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend,android --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "corepack pnpm run dev:backend" "corepack pnpm run dev:frontend:reset" "NODE_ENV=development corepack pnpm --dir OnMyWay_FE_V3 exec react-native run-android --no-packager --active-arch-only"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend,ios --prefix-colors blue,magenta,cyan "corepack pnpm run dev:backend" "corepack pnpm run dev:frontend" "corepack pnpm --dir OnMyWay_FE_V3 exec react-native run-ios --no-packager"
scripts.dev:ios:reset: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend,ios --prefix-colors blue,magenta,cyan "corepack pnpm run dev:backend" "corepack pnpm run dev:frontend:reset" "corepack pnpm --dir OnMyWay_FE_V3 exec react-native run-ios --no-packager"
scripts.prod:backend: corepack pnpm run build:backend && corepack pnpm run start:prod:backend
scripts.prod:android: corepack pnpm run build:backend && concurrently --names backend,android --prefix-colors blue,green "corepack pnpm run start:prod:backend" "corepack pnpm --dir OnMyWay_FE_V3 exec react-native run-android --mode release --no-packager"
scripts.prod:ios: corepack pnpm run build:backend && concurrently --names backend,ios --prefix-colors blue,cyan "corepack pnpm run start:prod:backend" "corepack pnpm --dir OnMyWay_FE_V3 exec react-native run-ios --mode Release --no-packager"
